oe_dec_act_grant_dominion_charter = {
	type = situation
	show_message = no
	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			OR = {
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				num_subjects >= 1
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			gold >= 120
			OR = {
				is_colonial_overlord = yes
				num_subjects >= 1
			}
		}
	}
	cooldown = { type = oe_dec_act_grant_dominion_charter_cd years = 4 }
	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = never
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		interaction_source_list = { situation:oe_sit_twilight_of_empires = { add_to_list = source } }
		target_flag = recipient
		name = choose_situation
		column = { data = name }
		visible = { this = situation:oe_sit_twilight_of_empires situation_is_active = yes }
	}
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_dec_init_country = yes
			add_gold = -120
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dec_mod_dominion_charter years = 6 mode = replace }
			every_subject = {
				limit = { is_rebel_country = no }
				add_liberty_desire = -18
			}
		}
		oe_dec_shift_global = { ref = 8 lib = -10 con = 6 }
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
}
